title: FSL applyxfm4D
description: Apply either one FSL affine per 4D volume from a MAT_0000-style directory, or one affine to every volume.

reference.desc: 3D reference NIfTI image defining the output grid.

out_file.desc: Requested output NIfTI path. applyxfm4D receives its extension-free stem and FSL appends the configured NIFTI or NIFTI_GZ suffix.

mat_dir.desc: Directory containing exactly MAT_0000 through MAT_NNNN, one FSL affine matrix per input volume.

single_matrix.desc: One FSL affine matrix applied to every input volume using applyxfm4D -singlematrix.
